text:
Maria G: Quick question — for the Snowflake <> Qdrant connector pilot, do we have an approved plan for EU data residency and cross-region vector indexing? I'm worried about embeddings copied into an external vector DB.

AJ: Short answer: not fully signed off. We have a draft design. We need to ensure no raw PII leaves the customer's Snowflake account and that vector derivatives are stored in an EU region when the account is EU-bound.

Liam: Two follow-ups — (1) can we do server-side tokenization/anonymization in the connector before embeddings are computed? (2) does Qdrant support BYOK or KMS integration for per-tenant keys?

Sarah P: For marketplace listing we'll need an explicit dataflow diagram + responsible disclosure on where embeddings live. Also legal wants sample contract language for EU customers.

AJ: On (1) yes — connector can run a preprocessor step. Proposed flow:

Snowflake -> connector preprocessor (tokenize/strip-pii) -> embedding service (hosted or customer) -> vector DB

If customer uses hosted embedding, we must route that to EU hosted embedding infra or require private embeddings in Dedicated/Private.

Maria G: Good. For (2) Qdrant supports KMS in their hosted offering but not per-tenant BYOK on their SaaS last I checked. We'll need to confirm for on-prem bundles.

Liam: If Qdrant can't do BYOK, we should offer two options in docs: (A) host vector DB in customer's VPC (Private deployment path) or (B) deploy a tenant-scoped encryption layer on the connector node.

partners-bot: Checklist created: [dataflow diagram, residency mapping, KMS requirements, contract language drafts, marketplace privacy blurb]. See docs link: https://internal.redwood/partnerships/connector-privacy-checklist

Sarah P: NOTE — marketplace compliance requires a statement like "Embeddings and derived vectors may be stored in third-party vector DBs. Customers in EU can opt to pin storage to EU regions or use Private deployment." We should get legal sign-off before publishing.

Maria G: Can someone own the engineering tasks? I can own the preprocessor POC. Who can take the KMS + deployment options assessment?

AJ: I'll take the KMS + region routing plan. ETA EOW for a short doc.

Liam: I'll prototype a connector config flag — sample config below:

connector:
  preprocess: pii_scrub
  embed_service: redwood-eu-embed
  vector_target:
    engine: qdrant
    region: eu-west-1
    kms: customer-kms:alias/my-tenant

Will push a sketch to the repo and flag for review.

Sarah P: I'll draft the marketplace blurb + legal framing. Ping me when the KMS doc lands.

Maria G: Awesome. Last ask — can we surface this as a compatibility badge for our marketplace listings if the partner supports EU residency + KMS? That would help sales.

partners-bot: Proposed badge criteria added to checklist.

ops-bot: FYI — if we enable region pinning we'll need a capacity reservation check for Dedicated pools in eu-west-1. Ops to confirm quota.

AJ: I'll coordinate with infra to validate capacity. Adding infra@ to the doc.

Liam: Quick question for the group: do we want the connector to optionally compute embeddings in-database (Snowflake UDF) to avoid moving text at all? Tradeoffs: latency and compute placement.

Maria G: I like the idea as an opt-in for high-sensitivity customers. Let's add as a long-term item; POC later.

Sarah P: TL;DR actions: Maria - preprocessor POC, AJ - KMS + routing doc, Liam - connector config POC, Sarah - marketplace + legal blurb. I'll collect by next Tue for partner sync.

Maria G: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
